0: AN ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH A HOUSE NUMBERING SYSTEM FOR TREUTLEN COUNTY AND TO PROVIDE METHODS FOR IMPLEMENTING A SYSTEM FOR THE ENFORCEMENT THEREOF.
2:
The Treutlen County Board of Commissioners has established a new address numbering system, which shall be administered by the Treutlen County Addressing Coordinator.

. Each house, building or occupiable structure shall be assigned a separate number. A number shall be assigned for each separate and distinct occupant or division (i.e. apartment, company, etc.) within a building or other occupied structure.

Existing numbers shall be changed only as necessary to insure the effectiveness or efficiency of the Enhanced 911 system in Treutlen County, as determined in the judgment of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners.

All new buildings and structures must be assigned a number address by the Treutlen County Addressing Coordinator prior to or simultaneous with granting a Septic Tank Permit or a Building Permit.

Written notification of the address assigned under the terms of this ordinance to each house, building or structure shall be given or delivered to its respective owner.

Written notification of the address assigned under the terms of this ordinance to each house, building or structure shall be given or delivered to the U. S. Postal 911 Address Coordinator.
3:
A. Within thirty (30) days of receiving notification of the house number assignment the owner, occupant or agent of each house, building or business shall display the assigned number on the structure.

B. The property owner, occupant or agent of each house, building or other structure, shall pay for cost and installation of the numbers.

C. Residential numbers shall not be less than three (3) inches in height. Business numbers shall not be less than six (6) inches in height. All numbers shall be made of durable, clearly visible material and shall contrast with the color of the house, building or other structure.

D. All numbers shall be conspicuously place immediately above, on or at the side of the appropriate door so that the number is clearly visible from the street. In cases where the building is situated more than fifty (50) feet from the street, the building number

shall be placed near the walk driveway or common entrance to the building or upon the mailbox, gatepost, fence or other appropriate place so as to be clearly visible from the street.

IN WITNESS THEREOF, the governing authority of Treutlen County, Georgia duly adopts this ordinance on the Second day of August 2005.
